correctness.rationale: The finite gasket and all three internal top-level junctions are specified exactly. Schur reduction has the needed +z shared-vertex correction. Direct algebra gives the two central resolvents P/(z A K) and (r/z)(r-5)P/(A T). Three explicit polynomial identities and algebraic-integrality arguments eliminate every pole cancellation; their reduced denominator degrees are 1+3*2^(g-2) and 5*2^(g-2). Finite self-adjoint spectral measures have simple observable poles and contribute one or two active channels by symmetry. Positive losses remove all and only the bright modes. A standard-library checker independently constructs exact Laplacian Krylov ranks modulo two primes for levels 1..5 (10 confirmations); finite checks do not substitute for the all-generation proof.

value.rationale: The exact central-junction trapping efficiency is a motivated transport question previously addressed only at finite levels: exact N-dependent dark dimensions control persistent coherent trapping. The result replaces a finite table by a full infinite-family classification with an exact asymptotic coefficient and identifies a roughly 30 percent greater bright fraction than three exterior-corner traps at high generation. The polynomial noncancellation mechanism is structurally nontrivial and relevant to central-vs-boundary detector placement. No general finite-time theorem is claimed.
